podcast.body: Featured on the multi-platinum All Killer No Filler album, this song was instrumental in Sum 41 becoming a ubiquitous "pop punk staple everywhere." "They broke out of Canada with a multi-platinum album and a song called Fat Lip."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is referenced as a benchmark for high YouTube view numbers, indicating its significant popularity and status as a known hit for the band. "kind of like the same as fat lip numbers and I just couldn't ever understand it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Sum 41 Story As Told By Deryck Whibley: Part 2

podcast.body: This song was particularly successful in Japan, where it "took off right away," contributing to the early international success of the "All Killer No Filler" album. "Japan took off with Fat Lips right away, yeah."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
